references.text: Psalm 24:1 emphasizes God's sovereignty over all that He owns, which is similar to the owner's right to do as he wishes in Matthew 20:15.
Philippians 1:15 can be viewed in light of Matthew 20:15 by highlighting people's different motives and how God's goodness and sovereignty stand above human judgments.
Proverbs 15:3 speaks of the Lord's eyes seeing everything, which relates to the eye mentioned in Matthew 20:15 and the idea of God's all-seeing justice.
Romans 9:20–21 discusses the Creator's right to shape creation according to His will, paralleling the owner's right in Matthew 20:15 to do as he wishes with what belongs to him.
